meta.description: Coordinate parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions with finding deduplication, severity calibration, and consolidated reporting. Use this skill when organizing multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

copy.tagline: 协调多路并行代码审查，去重并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常组织多人代码审查并需统一汇总反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel code reviews, deduplicate findings, and consolidate results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often organize code review with multiple reviewers and need consolidated feedback.

howto.what: 它会按安全、性能、架构等多个维度并行组织代码评审,把不同评审人重复的发现合并去重,统一评定严重级别(严重/高/中/低),最后输出一份合并后的评审报告。
howto.when: 当你要组织多维度代码评审、统一校准问题严重级别,或合并多份评审结果时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我按安全、性能、架构三个维度评审这个 PR
say.note: 会分配维度并汇总各维度发现

say.text: 把几位评审人报的问题去重合并成一份报告
say.note: 同一处同一问题会合并并署上所有评审人

howto.what_en: It organizes parallel code reviews across dimensions such as security, performance, and architecture, merges duplicate findings, calibrates severity levels, and produces one consolidated review report.
howto.when_en: Use it when organizing a multi-dimensional code review, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating results from multiple reviewers.

say_en.text: Review this PR across security, performance, and architecture
Dedupe these reviewer findings into one merged report
say_en.note: Same file:line and issue get merged with credit
